title: Sensitivity bound by equal rotation steps
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ be measurable, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $\ell$ be a positive natural number. Then the Gaussian rotation sensitivity satisfies $$s_A(\delta)\le \ell\,s_A(\delta/\ell).$$
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. Write $s_A(t)$ for the real value of the product-measure mass $(\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n)\{(g,h):\mathbf1_A(g)\ne\mathbf1_A(\cos t\,g+\sin t\,h)\}$. For any measurable $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$, real $\delta$, and positive integer $\ell$, $s_A(\delta)\le\ell\,s_A(\delta/\ell)$.
